title: Chapter 66 — The Designer Referral Engine
intro: The book referring itself and the connector position.

sections.title: Referrals Between Trade Accounts
sections.content:
Designers know builders. Builders know contractors. Contractors know property managers. Your trade book can refer itself if you position yourself as the connector.

Ask every satisfied trade account: 'Who else do you work with that I should meet?' The referral from one trade professional to another carries enormous credibility.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating trade referrals, ask:

Is the salesperson asking for trade-to-trade referrals?
Are they positioning themselves as a connector in the local trade community?
